package onboarding

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func (dialog *testDialog) MaterializeCanonicalStudentTurn(_ context.Context, input domain.CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	dialog.mu.Lock()
	dialog.materializeCalls++
	dialog.mu.Unlock()
	normalized, err := input.Normalize()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	message := domain.DialogMessage{
		ID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("canonical-message", normalized.CanonicalMessageCommandID), DialogID: normalized.DialogID,
		AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, SenderID: normalized.StudentID,
		ReplyToMessageID: normalized.SourceMessageID, Body: normalized.Body, Status: 1, Version: 1,
		MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 8, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
	return message, nil
}

func TestConcurrentDifferentCanonicalActionsMaterializeOnePromptExactlyOnce(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, _ := newTestService()
	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = true
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	service.CanonicalMessages = dialog
	session, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	messageID, messageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, session)
	requests := []domain.AssistantUIActionRequest{
		actionRequest(messageID, messageVersion, "onboarding.goal.d0.v2", "goal.learn_programming", "91919191-9191-4191-8191-919191919191"),
		actionRequest(messageID, messageVersion, "onboarding.goal.d0.v2", "goal.learn_programming", "92929292-9292-4292-8292-929292929292"),
	}
	start := make(chan struct{})
	var wait sync.WaitGroup
	wait.Add(len(requests))
	errorsByAction := make([]error, len(requests))
	for index := range requests {
		go func(index int) {
			defer wait.Done()
			<-start
			_, errorsByAction[index] = service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, requests[index])
		}(index)
	}
	close(start)
	wait.Wait()
	successes, conflicts := 0, 0
	for _, actionErr := range errorsByAction {
		switch actionErr {
		case nil:
			successes++
		case domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict:
			conflicts++
		default:
			t.Fatalf("unexpected action error: %v", actionErr)
		}
	}
	if successes != 1 || conflicts != 1 || dialog.materializeCalls != 1 || student.replaceCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("success=%d conflict=%d materialize=%d student=%d", successes, conflicts, dialog.materializeCalls, student.replaceCalls)
	}
}

func TestCanonicalActionMaterializesDialogOnlyAndReplays(t *testing.T) {
	service, _, _, store := newTestService()
	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = true
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	session, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	messageID, messageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, session)
	service.Students = nil
	service.StructuredMessages = nil
	service.PlainMessages = nil
	service.CanonicalMessages = service.Dialogs.(interface {
		MaterializeCanonicalStudentTurn(context.Context, domain.CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization) (domain.DialogMessage, error)
	})
	request := actionRequest(messageID, messageVersion, "onboarding.goal.d0.v2", "goal.learn_programming", "93939393-9393-4939-8939-939393939393")
	first, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	if err != nil || first.V2 == nil || first.V2.Schema != domain.AssistantUIActionResultV2Schema || !first.V2.Materialized || first.V2.Replayed {
		t.Fatalf("first=%+v err=%v", first, err)
	}
	if len(store.items) != 1 || store.items[request.IdempotencyKey].CanonicalStudentMessageID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("receipt=%+v", store.items)
	}
	replayed, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	if err != nil || replayed.V2 == nil || !replayed.V2.Replayed || replayed.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID != first.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID {
		t.Fatalf("replayed=%+v err=%v", replayed, err)
	}
	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = false
	flagOffReplay, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	if err != nil || flagOffReplay.V2 == nil || !flagOffReplay.V2.Replayed || flagOffReplay.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID != first.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID {
		t.Fatalf("flag-off replay=%+v err=%v", flagOffReplay, err)
	}
	conflict := request
	conflict.IdempotencyKey = "94949494-9494-4949-8949-949494949494"
	if _, err = service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, conflict); err == nil || err != domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable {
		t.Fatalf("different key err=%v", err)
	}
}

func TestCanonicalFlagRequiresUnifiedCoordinator(t *testing.T) {
	service, _, _, _ := newTestService()
	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = true
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false
	if _, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, actionRequest(testDialogID, 1, "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", "direction.backend", "95959595-9595-4959-8959-959595959595")); err != domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v", err)
	}
}
